definition.scope: one case, one saved time frame, all BIW nodes
definition.node_weighting: ordinary equal node weights; no area weighting
definition.magnitude: norm([Ux, Uy, Uz]); magnitude is formed before computing R2
definition.initial_frame: known t=0 boundary condition; R2=null and curve gap
definition.constant_truth: SST=0 -> R2=null; no epsilon or force-finite replacement
definition.mean_frame_r2: arithmetic mean of defined per-frame R2 values, not pooled R2
